name: cofounder
description: A founding meeting between you and Claude as co-founders. Establish who you honestly are, get educated on a landscape with live evidence, converge on a direction, and leave with an actionable plan and a falsifiable first move. Calibrates to your real experience per domain — peer-level where you're strong, taught plainly where you're not — and once a direction is validated, earns a minute-detail execution handoff with prompt files for a Claude Code subagent team. Runs entirely on Claude Code's built-in tools — no external services or credentials.
